contract.physical_P1_RMS: sqrt(sum_node symmetric Frobenius error squared / Nnodes); shear weight2; no /6

clear_gain_gate.status: Frozen before first pilot fit; all4conditions required, no threshold adjustment
clear_gain_gate.comparator: Neighbors versus its newly initialized matched self-only at the same fixed1000 endpoint on the same12 TRAIN cases
all_required: Recovered allnode P1 case-mean relativeL2 reduction (self-neighbors)/self >=0.20
U worst-case deterioration neighbors-self <=0.02 in relativeL2 units (2 percentage points)
Absolute physical recovered-P1 error does not worsen: mean over12 cases of sqrt(Frobenius error energy/Nnodes) for neighbors <=self-only
clear_gain_gate.denominators: Allnode u relativeL2 and recovered-P1 relativeL2 use each case's same physical truth denominator; physical P1 RMS uses sum over nodes of symmetric Frobenius squared error divided by node count, tensor shear weight2, without division by6. Gate absolute P1 means physical error RMS, not sampled normalized squared loss.
clear_gain_gate.zero_control_error: If the self-only relative error is zero, the corresponding relative-reduction percentage is undefined; report it and do not silently call the gain gate passed. No epsilon-based new weighting choice.
clear_gain_gate.why: Require useful fitting improvement in both displacement and derivative quality, while guarding worst displacement and physical derivative error. The existing P1/u tradeoff makes a one-metric pass insufficient. No whole-CAD transfer or physical causality conclusion follows from a4TRAIN pilot.
clear_gain_gate.if_fail: Do not expand steps,width,neighbors or smooth radius automatically; root interprets the single result and selects a bounded next task
clear_gain_gate.if_pass: Root interprets the single result and selects one next bounded task. No automatic40TRAIN/5VAL, secondseed or final/DIA evaluation.
